core_meaning.primary_meaning: Kutub corresponds to the Arabic form كتب and is glossed in this record as “Books, writings.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Kutub corresponds to the Arabic form كتب (Plural of كِتَاب; كُتُب (Kutub)). Its core sense is books, writings. Kutub is Arabic كُتُب (Kutub) 'books, writings', the plural of كِتَاب (kitāb). The source gloss 'Repository of Knowledge' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun.

persian.name: کتب
persian.long_meaning: Kutub (کتب) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن کتب، کتابها است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: कुतुब

arabic.name: كتب
